title: Introduce anticipatory circuit hold and SLO oscillation dampener
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: We observed oscillatory behavior across regional SLO enforcement when transient capacity pressure caused rapid open/close cycles in circuit states that produced cascading retries and uneven load shedding. This PR introduces two mechanisms: an anticipatory circuit hold that puts a circuit into a short non-terminal hold when upstream signals predict imminent overload, and an SLO oscillation dampener that aggregates breach signals with exponential decay and requires a sustained dampened score before triggering soft-fallbacks. Changes are opt-in and provide operator knobs for tuning.

release_notes: Adds an anticipatory circuit hold and an SLO oscillation dampener to reduce circuit flapping during short-lived regional spikes. Feature is off by default and available behind console toggles. Canaried rollout for hosted tenants.
discussion: Context and tradeoffs: incidents showed rapid open/close cycles causing retry storms and uneven shedding. The team debated hold duration versus availability impact, probe frequency, and how to avoid masking real degradation. The chosen approach favors short holds and conservative defaults, with a probe scheduler that uses progressive backoff and jitter. Testing: deterministic unit tests for state transitions plus stochastic surge simulation. Post-merge tasks: add runbook entry, create canary dashboard, and add an alert that fires if anticipatory_hold_active exceeds 5 percent of tenants for more than five minutes during canary. Operator guidance: monitor slo_dampen_score and anticipatory_hold_active metrics and use console toggles to disable if needed. Rollback: disable anticipatory_hold via UI and revert config in the next patch release if required.
review_conversation: Ethan asked for clarifications on threshold tuning and rollback safety and requested a canary rollout plan; author added canary flags and conservative defaults. Marta suggested an override when backend health is known-good; author added an override and tests. Samir requested additional telemetry for probe latency; probe_backoff_ms metric was added. All reviewers approved after two rounds of minor changes.
ci_summary: Unit tests passed. Integration smoke passed on Linux and Mac runners. Lint passed. Microbench performance variance was within acceptable bounds (+2 percent on a narrow path), investigated and accepted.
runtime_notes: Feature is opt-in for Dedicated and Private. Hosted rollout will begin with a 10 percent tenant canary for 48 hours followed by a staged ramp. Defaults are conservative to avoid user-visible regressions. Operators should watch new metrics and the canary dashboard.
